# Tiger Safaris in India

> Tiger Safaris in India (tigersafarisinindia.com) is a private safari operator that plans tiger safaris and jungle stays in five Indian tiger reserves: Ranthambore, Jim Corbett, Panna, Satpura and Sariska. We arrange safari zone planning, permits on the traveller's behalf through the official forest department systems, naturalist guides, hotels and lodges near the park gates, and transfers. Bookings are enquiry-led: travellers send an enquiry and receive a tailored quote. We are not a government or forest department website.

Key facts:
- Coverage: Ranthambore (Rajasthan), Sariska (Rajasthan), Jim Corbett (Uttarakhand), Panna (Madhya Pradesh), Satpura (Madhya Pradesh)
- Services: jeep and canter safari planning, walking and boat safaris where permitted, hotel and lodge selection by distance to safari gate, single-park and multi-park tours
- Audience: Indian and international travellers
- Fees, timings and zone rules change each season; park pages state an "as of" date and link the official source
- Enquiries: https://tigersafarisinindia.com/plan-your-safari/

- [Jim Corbett tiger safari](https://tigersafarisinindia.com/jim-corbett/): Park guide, zones (Dhikala, Bijrani, Jhirna and others), best time, stays
- [Panna tiger safari](https://tigersafarisinindia.com/panna/): Park guide, Ken river, Khajuraho pairing
- [Satpura tiger safari](https://tigersafarisinindia.com/satpura/): Park guide, walking and boat safaris
- [Sariska tiger safari](https://tigersafarisinindia.com/sariska/): Park guide, day trips from Delhi and Jaipur
